<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />8 - Meter number changed</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="8">

This message is generated for a system when a change to the meter number for a meter in the system is saved in the Meter Editor.

- Date 1 Usage: New Meter Number
- Data 2 Usage: Old Meter Number
- Message Class: 3 (Information)
- Message Priority: 5 (Logged)
